Q1 · SWOT

Strong product, open market: the barriers are a checklist, not a wall

Strengths

Inside GIMBER
  • 33–40% real organic ginger
  • One bottle, 35 drinks, hot or cold
  • Lean and profitable: +€2.1 m

Weaknesses

Inside GIMBER
  • Unknown brand in the UAE
  • Premium price next to syrups
  • No local team or importer yet

Opportunities

Outside, in Dubai
  • 0.0% is the norm, not a niche
  • Wellness is mainstream: 3 m+ joined DFC
  • Sugar tax: N°1 diluted pays AED 0

Threats

Outside, in Dubai
  • Tourism shock: visitors −44%
  • Lyre’s and Monin on bar menus
  • Registration, label and permit rules
The threats become a checklist
  • Importer
  • Arabic label
  • Excise certificate
  • Advertiser permit

Frameworks: company and environment (Session 1), analysis to SWOT (Session 3). Sources: Dubai DET; Dubai Media Office; Federal Tax Authority (Dec 2025); gimber.com; company accounts.

Q9 · Cultural research

Keep the Belgian bottle, adapt the experience: language, serves and calendar

=جيمبر

Arabic name on the sleeve and gift box

We keep

  • The recipe and the name
  • “0% alcohol. 200% kick.”
  • The apothecary bottle

We adapt

  • Label in Arabic and English
  • Serves: iftar with a date
  • Tone of hospitality

Do

  • Pour and serve with the right hand
  • Show families, friends and guests
  • Sample after iftar in Ramadan
  • Write Arabic first

Don’t

  • Put national symbols on a pack
  • Joke about alcohol or use bar codes
  • Make health claims
  • Quote scripture in advertising

Cultural calendar 2027

JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec

Gulfood15–19 Mar

Frameworks: standardisation vs adaptation, cultural research (Session 8). The Starbucks case in Australia: local taste cannot be assumed. Sources: UAE labelling and Advertiser Permit rules; The National; Austrade. Islamic dates depend on moon sighting.

Likelihood
  • 1

  • The right importer
  • Compliant on day one
  • A place on the menu
  • One premium story
  • Cultural fit
  • A retention engine
  • Learn faster
